description: The Pi extension events the Jentrix extension subscribes to (it runs in-process — nothing here is a command Pi executes) and the ledger lines it appends for the Jentrix session host. Credentials and session bytes never leave the machine through this extension; the ledger is 0600 under the operator's home.

env.PI_SESSION_ID: Pi's own: this session's id in every bash tool command
env.PI_SESSION_FILE: Pi's own: this session's file (empty under --no-session)
